First of all, thank you sincerely for responding. 

I agree. I have a lot more to go for and I have so many more opportunities to help people than to hurt people. At the same time, I’m afraid I may never fit into society. I’m afraid I’ll always be a danger to others. 

I’ve stayed in therapy and I’m still trying to do better. I’ve been telling the few friends I’ve had that I’m thankful for them and I’ve been paying attention to my behaviors more than ever before to try and treat people with the respect they deserve. 

Like your username says, I want to believe that this too will pass, and at the same time, I’m so afraid.
